Subject: Go-live orchestration — hotline & escalation roster

Hi Alan / Sara,

As we ramp toward the Feb 28 go-live, we need one final orchestration call to lock owners for cutover, fallback policies, the 24/48-hour hotline rota, and procurement signoff steps. Goal: one 60-min meeting where we agree on owners, publish the hotline contacts, and confirm the rollback conditions.

Proposed agenda (high level):
- Introductions & objectives (5 min)
- Cutover sequence & timing (15 min)
- Fallback/rollback triggers and owners (15 min)
- Hotline / escalation roster (10 min)
- Procurement & legal checklist (5 min)
- Action items & next steps (10 min)

Proposed windows (all PT):
- Tue Feb 16 — 10:00–11:00 or 15:00–16:00
- Wed Feb 17 — 09:00–10:00 or 14:00–15:00

Please let us know which window works and who from Acme must attend (engineering lead, procurement, security). I attached a draft hotline CSV and the current playbook.

If procurement cannot make these windows, indicate an alternate and we’ll prioritize.

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0132

Also: security would like the escalation roster to include an on-call POC and an email alias (not just individual phones). Can Redwood support an alias that maps to your on-call? If so, we can exercise it in a tabletop before production.
